# Quantech — Campus Management & School ERP

> A modern school operating system that works like an Organiser. Built for CBSE, ICSE, and State Board schools, PU colleges, and multi-branch educational trusts.

## Overview
Quantech is a comprehensive campus ERP and student information management system that automates school administration, fee collection, student attendance, marksheet generation, and parent communication.

- **Website**: https://imsportal.3ftech.in
- **Target Audience**: School Trustees, Principals, Administrators, Teachers, Students, and Parents.
- **Coverage**: CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, Degree Colleges, and Multi-Campus Trusts across India.

## Key Capabilities & Features

### 1. Admissions & Student Management
- Online & in-person digital admission workflows.
- Secure digital KYC student document vaults (Aadhaar, Transfer Certificate, Birth Certificate).
- Automated roll number & student ID assignment.
- Compliant with APAAR, PEN, and UDISE+ student registries.

### 2. Zero-Reconciliation Fee Collection
- Automated term & monthly fee ledger tracking.
- Instant UPI QR codes, debit/credit cards, and NetBanking payments.
- Automatic digital receipt generation with zero reconciliation lag.
- Automated WhatsApp fee payment reminders with direct payment links sent to parents.

### 3. Examination & 1-Click Marksheets
- Pre-configured assessment engines for CBSE 9-point grading, ICSE bifurcation, and State Board frameworks.
- Automated calculation of scholastic marks, co-scholastic grades, term aggregates, and attendance percentages.
- 1-click generation of board-compliant report cards with digital QR verification.

### 4. Smart Attendance Tracking
- Dedicated Android Facial Recognition Kiosk App for tablets and wall-mount devices.
- Teacher mobile roll-call app with offline caching and multi-period attendance.
- Automated instant WhatsApp notifications to parents within 3 minutes of student absence.

### 5. Multi-Branch Campus & Trust Governance
- Centralized multi-campus dashboard with strict role-based access control (Super Admin, Branch Admin, Principal, Accountant, Teacher, Student).
- Comprehensive staff payroll, biometric employee attendance, and departmental analytics.
- Live GPS school bus fleet tracking with real-time ETA alerts for parents.

## Pricing

- **Campus Pro Plan**: ₹59 / student / year.
  - Includes full core ERP modules, automated fees, marksheet generation, parent WhatsApp alerts, and complimentary physical high-durability PVC student ID cards with custom campus branding.
- **Trust & Group Plan (Enterprise)**: Custom pricing for multi-campus chains, universities, and large school trusts requiring hardware integrations and dedicated account management.
